name: Yuuri
source:
A maid-type cosroid who makes many mistakes but tries her best to do her best. She has a positive personality. She is younger than her age.

She also does her best to serve you, but she is not very good at it. She has a “passive charm” that the main character develops by doing various things to her.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/cosroid/index.html]official site[/url]]
